name: Pipeweed Farmer
description:
A field that is harvested and replanted from its own seeds, with the by-products sorted into piles.

Bots:
• Pipeweed Farmer

In each area:
• Crop(Pipeweed): till the soil (nothing to build)
• Seeds of crop(Pipeweed): a barrel on this one-tile spot (it lies in the corner of the Fresh Leaf of Pipeweed area); seeds are stored in it and taken from it for sowing
• Fresh Leaf of Pipeweed: nothing to build: the bot piles Fresh Leaf of Pipeweed here (or put a container in it)

Also needed:
• The Seed Trough preset, placed once near your fields: the bot will not start without a trough area.
